sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.text: Name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, gender, mobile number, email, blood group, an optional photo, Aadhaar and Voter ID numbers, and your constituency and address details.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text: Only for membership registration, identity verification, communication and running the organisation. We never sell it or share it with third parties.

sections.heading: Security
sections.text: Aadhaar and Voter ID numbers are stored encrypted. Coordinators can only see members in their own area, and even then only the last four digits.

sections.heading: QR code
sections.text: The QR code on your card holds only a random verification token. Scanning it shows your name, member ID, role, district and status — never your phone number, address or ID numbers.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text: To correct your details or delete your membership, write to nmpiofficial2026@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.text: Any Indian citizen aged 18 or over may become a member.

sections.heading: Accurate information
sections.text: Everything you provide must be true and your own. Registrations found to be false may be cancelled.

sections.heading: ID card
sections.text: The digital ID card remains the property of the organisation. Misusing it or lending it to others is not allowed.

sections.heading: Conduct
sections.text: Members must act lawfully, with discipline and respect for others.

sections.heading: Suspension
sections.text: The organisation may suspend or cancel the membership of anyone who breaks these terms.

items.q: How do I get my digital ID card?
items.a: You can download it straight after registering. Later, log in and download it again any time from your profile page.

items.q: Does the QR code expose my phone number or address?
items.a: No. The QR code holds only a secure verification token. Scanning it shows just your name, member ID, district and status.

items.q: Are my Aadhaar and Voter ID safe?
items.a: Yes. Both are stored encrypted, and even administrators only see the last four digits.
Area coordinators can put a registration under review or suspend it. Please contact your district team or our office.

items.q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
items.a: Contact our office and we will help after verifying your identity. If you are logged in, you can change it on your profile page.

ideologyPage.title: Policies & Principles
ideologyPage.subtitle: Guided by Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's ideals of patriotic service, discipline and equality.

principles.title: Creating a Drug-Free India
principles.text: We will work towards creating a drug-free India. Strict action will be taken against those involved in tobacco, cannabis, alcohol, injectable drugs, tablets and other forms of substance abuse.

principles.title: Protection of Women and Children
principles.text: The safety and protection of women, girls and children will be ensured. Appropriate measures will be taken to protect children and provide them with a safe environment.

principles.title: Free Education & Free Medical Care
principles.text: Free education and free medical treatment should reach the people effectively and directly.

principles.title: Free Ambulance & Auto Services
principles.text: Free ambulance services will be established in every district. Free auto services will also be arranged for senior citizens and persons with disabilities.

principles.title: Employment Opportunities for Youth
principles.text: Employment camps will be conducted for educated youngsters, and employment opportunities will be created by connecting them with leading companies.

principles.title: “Food Is the Medicine for Hunger”
principles.text: Under the initiative “Food Is the Medicine for Hunger,” arrangements will be made to provide food to poor and needy people every day, with support available around the clock.

principles.title: A Caste-Free Society
principles.text: We will work beyond language, religion and caste differences. A local office will be established in every area to promote equality and a caste-free society.

principles.title: Government Welfare Schemes for People
principles.text: District-level administrators will be appointed to identify people living below the poverty line and ensure that government welfare schemes reach them directly, helping improve their livelihood.

principles.title: Free Medical Assistance
principles.text: Free medical insurance/support and assistance will be provided to needy patients to help them receive quality medical treatment.

principles.title: “Our Women Are the Eyes of the Nation”
principles.text: Under the initiative “Our Women Are the Eyes of the Nation,” support groups, employment opportunities and assistance through vocational opportunities/loans will be provided for widowed women.

welfare.title: “Your Vote Is Your Right”
welfare.text: People will be educated about the importance of their vote through regular awareness programmes and small public consultation meetings under the theme “Your Vote Is Your Right.”

welfare.title: Addressing Local Problems
welfare.text: Every Sunday, our administrators should visit their respective areas, streets and local branches, identify public issues and conduct meetings with our volunteers to find solutions.

welfare.title: Dedication to People’s Welfare
welfare.text: Every administrator should consider the welfare of the people as their highest responsibility and work with complete dedication to protect their rights and welfare.

welfare.title: Support During Temple & Public Events
welfare.text: During temple festivals, Jallikattu events and other major public functions, local administrators and volunteers should work together to arrange water stalls, buttermilk stalls and other public service facilities.

welfare.title: “A Journey Towards Freedom Again”
welfare.text: Once every three months, or once a month where necessary, public awareness programmes will be conducted under the theme “A Journey Towards Freedom Again.”

welfare.title: Action Against Non-Performing Administrators
welfare.text: Administrators who continuously fail to perform their responsibilities for six months will be removed from their positions. The movement will not provide them with opportunities to contest in future elections.

welfare.title: Low-Cost Tuition Centres
welfare.text: Low-cost tuition centres will be established to support children’s education and improve their future opportunities.

welfare.title: District Offices
welfare.text: District presidents and district secretaries should work together to establish offices in every district. This should be implemented as soon as possible.

welfare.title: Free Legal Consultation Centres
welfare.text: With the assistance of police personnel and legal professionals, free legal consultation centres should be established in every district to help people with legal issues.
